Theta GmbH’s strategy of filing multiple patents for next-generation wireless communication poses a significant threat to our business. By securing a temporary monopoly on key technologies, they are likely to create substantial barriers to entry, potentially stalling our development roadmap and forcing us to invest time and resources into finding alternative solutions. This could delay our time-to-market and increase R&D costs, giving Theta a competitive advantage in the short to medium term. We should consider engaging in cross-licensing negotiations or accelerating our own patent filings to mitigate this risk.

Regarding your priority question: A book is primarily made of paper.
